goal: Play a full round: put out fires, rescue everyone, refill water
summary: The playtester tried to grab gear from the locker room racks before starting the round. Every interact on the Axe and Extinguisher racks (steps 1, 3, 5, 6, 7) returned 'held, not triggered', so the backpack stayed empty and the playtester gave up at step 8. No fires were fought, no one was rescued, and no water was refilled, so the goal was not met.

bugs.title: Gear Rack ProximityPrompts never trigger (backpack stays empty)
bugs.evidence: Steps 1, 3, 6 and 7: 'Grab Axe' on GearRack1 returned 'held, not triggered' at 7.8 and about 3.8 studs, with the prompt reported in range (range 9). Step 5: 'Grab Extinguisher' on GearRack2 gave the same result. Carrying stayed "" in every observation. This blocks all gear pickup and so the whole round. The probe logged no server errors, so the cause is likely a prompt/handler setup problem, such as the prompt being disabled, a hold-duration or enabled-state mismatch, or the round being stuck in the Lobby state.

bugs.title: Round appears stuck in Lobby and gear is unavailable
bugs.evidence: The playtester's notes at step 7 say RoundState was still 'Lobby' and the HUD showed 'empty hands'. Gear racks may be gated on round state without telling the player. No feedback or message explained why the prompts did nothing. Note that the round state is only reported by the playtester, not seen in the trace observations.
